test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 09 Dec 2022 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: The world’s largest river lies in which of the following continent?
solution:
The correct answer is __**South America**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Amazon River__ is the largest river in the world.
 
• The Amazon basin is the largest drainage basin in the world.
 
• The Amazon River is the second-longest river (Only to the Nile), in the world.
 
• Amazon river in South America is the largest river in the world while Nile river in Africa is the longest river in the world.
 
• It is the** longest and largest river flows through South America**.
 
• The Amazon river originates in the Andes Mountains of Peru.
 
• It flows through the countries of Peru, Bolivia, Venezuela, Colombia, Ecuador, and Brazil.
 
• Amazon river discharges its water into the Atlantic Ocean.
 
• There are no bridges across the entire width of the Amazon river.
 
• Most part of the Amazon river flows through Brazil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

__
 
• The world’s largest river- Amazon (South America)
 
• The world’s longest river- Nile (Africa)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__****South America **

__
 
• South America is the fourth__ largest continent in the world.
 
• The area of South America is 17.84 million sq. km and stands at fourth in terms of area.
 
• There are 14 countries in this continent.
 
• Brazil is the largest country and Suriname is the smallest country in this country.
 
• The longest mountain (fold) chain in the world 'Andes' is located in this country.
 
• The largest river of the world, river Amazon flows here and along with its tributaries drains Peru, Bolivia, Columbia, Ecuador, Venezuela, and Brazil.
 
• Amazon forms the world's most diverse Biological hotspot here, the rain forests of Amazon also called 'the lungs of the Earth'.
 
• The world's highest navigable lake, Lake Titicaca is located here between Peru and Bolivia.
 
• Amazon, Orinoco, Parana, Uruguay, and Paraguay are the major river flowing through this continent.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• Following is the area-wise rank of seven continents:
 
 
• Asia> Africa> North America> South America> Antarctica> Europe > Australia.
